title: Four Special Directions over Prime Fields: Structure and Complete Classification
summary: A direction of the affine plane $\mathbb{F}_p^2$ is special for a set if the lines in that direction do not all meet the set in the same number of points. We classify, for every prime $p\ge5$, the subsets of $\mathbb{F}_p^2$ with exactly four special directions. There are $54$ affine-equivalence classes, occurring only for $p=5,7,11,13,17$, and we give explicit representatives. In particular, $17$ is the largest prime admitting such a set, which answers a question of Ghidelli, Kiss and Somlai, and over $\mathbb{F}_{13}$ the minimum size is $65$, attained by exactly two classes.
